mechanism: Static componentwise Z4 signed-list tree, reversible compaction and unique root join
source_model: n=b(a+1), k=2^a disjoint physical blocks, L=4^b distinct fixed supports per leaf
overflow_rule: Reject whole attempt on ANY overflow; never silently truncate and accept
time_and_coherent_space: O(k*C^2*poly(n,m,log C)), including retained comparison/count histories
source_mass_obligations: IID uniform original coarse labels before source or syndrome postselection
Independent complete unfiltered affine mark seed
Capacity at least 256*ceil(M)*k*L for the inherited lower bound
Reciprocal endpoint check, nonzero higher label check and full cleanup
falsifiers: Any disagreement with full native graph on nonoverflow inputs
Any nonzero workspace after XOR-F, including failure or nonzero target wires
Any accepted overflow or one-sided proposal promoted to a physical pair
Any use of packed cyclic addition instead of componentwise Z4 addition
Any data-dependent slot count, erased comparator history or free QRAM assumption
remaining_proof_obligations: Independent mathematical review of native moment and overflow bounds
Explicit low-level gate export if physical gate counts are to be claimed
Actual natural-source joint noise and independent batch supply
Escape from one-output growing-depth recursion, hard reduction and final decoder
Matched known classical and quantum sieve comparison
